summary: Independently verified proposal fact 0 against owned caller and canonical boss helper. Scalar output, strict threshold, unscaled near-target difference and x/y-only writes agree with functionality.md. Inspected all six upstream non-retain claims' cited code; compiled/history/alias deferrals accepted.

proposed_facts.reason: The canonical caller passes target xC, output x18, threshold x2C and factor x28. The helper declares the output as float*, computes three-dimensional distance, writes zero without scaling the difference below the strict threshold, otherwise stores distance and normalizes/scales the difference, then assigns only x/y self velocity. This supports the replacement of the two-vector description and agrees with functionality.md. Canonical state destinations also support the document's entry-name interpretations without relying on rendered names or numeric symbol components.

contradictions.reason: The two-vector claim is contradicted by the helper's Vec3* target and float* output signature. Proposal fact 0 correctly supersedes it and preserves the exceptional near-target branch.
Accepted deferral of all three .sdata2 claims: source-level zero/one uses do not establish compiled pool attribution, section size, IEEE storage layout or ordering.

Accepted deferral of the debug-menu/testing-history claim. The slot-type guard and empty shared hook establish current dispatch behavior, not historical developer intent. The rendered CrazyHand-specific name does not establish exclusive ownership.

Accepted deferral of the harau alias and associated external identification. The strict boundary branch and terminal helper prove entry into SweepWait, not an asset alias. Equality repeats SweepLoop; neither unconditional leftward displacement nor later storage cleanup is inferred.
